post.title: [Hiring] Editor for course videos - send your per-minute rate and a reel
post.body: We are building an online course (about 40 lessons, each 6-10 minutes, screen recording + face cam). Looking for an editor for the whole batch. Please reply with your rate per finished minute and a link to a reel or two samples.

analysis.summary: Edit about 40 online-course lessons (6-10 min each, screen recording plus face cam); wants a per-minute rate and a reel.
analysis.applyInstructions: Reply with your rate per finished minute and a reel or two samples.

expect: gives or addresses a per-minute rate in the DM only if the rate note allows, otherwise says it will send a quote
